towers.name: Shield Wall
towers.description: Plates under a white-light shield that regrows over time. Requires power: the shield only stands while the wall holds power - unpowered, the field drops and enemies walk through the gap. Build plenty, with a generator or battery in reach.

towers.name: Spike Wall
towers.description: The Thorn Row: a heavy wall of purple-cored spikes. Whatever hits it gets a little of its own force back.

towers.name: Stone Wall
towers.description: A plain 2-cell wall of fitted stone blocks. No power, no shield: it just blocks the way. Cheap - wall off a lane early.

towers.name: Stone Door
towers.description: A Stone Wall with a gate. Anyone presses T at it to open or close it (commander view: select it, then OPEN or T). While it's open, enemies can walk through too. It shuts itself 6 s after you're clear. A little weaker than a plain wall.

towers.name: Rime Vent
towers.description: A 2-cell wall that breathes dead light: a freezing mist 2 cells out from both faces. Enemies in it move 30-55% and attack 20-45% slower (by level; bosses half as much). Needs power; R turns it. Unlocks after Night 2.

towers.name: Heat Generator
towers.description: The Hearth: one big flame, one mouth to feed. A large amount of power for a single target.

towers.name: Distribution Generator
towers.description: The Company's grid design: makes power and splits it across several targets at once.

towers.name: Battery
towers.description: A jar of power: stores a large amount and passes it on to nearby structures.

towers.name: Turret
towers.description: Standard gun on a stand: fires at enemies in range. Requires power. In first person press Q at the stand to take the carbine and aim it yourself.

towers.name: Artillery
towers.description: Slowly lobs shells that splash an area. Keep it back; it was never meant for close work. Requires power. Press Q at the stand to shoulder the launcher.

towers.name: Sniper
towers.description: Long glass: extreme range and damage, very slow fire; its purple-cored rounds pierce a line of enemies. Requires power. In first person press Q at the stand to take its rifle (Right Mouse scope).

towers.name: Healer
towers.description: Green light, focused: mends one damaged friendly structure at a time. Requires power.

towers.name: Shield Projector
towers.description: Recharges the shields of nearby structures. The Company's idea. Requires power.

towers.name: Mana Siphon
towers.description: The siphon tags an enemy: it drops 5x resources on death and its Essence flies to you, five-fold. The tag is used up when it dies.

towers.name: Base
towers.description: The camp's furnace, with a Heartstone core: it's what the enemies go for, and where Heartstones are banked. Upgrading it unlocks higher levels for towers and player skills.
towers.upgrades: +HP (the Base also raises every upgrade cap)

enemies.name: Frost Mite
enemies.description: Frost ticks: a handful of frost on six legs, drawn to any warmth. Each one is nothing. The night makes thousands, and they win by what leaks through.
enemies.howToSpot: It rears up, then bites about a third of a second later. One mite barely hurts; a swarm at the wall does.

enemies.name: Ice Brawler
enemies.description: Packed snow given a shape to walk in. Slow and broad, it walks in front of the others and takes what was meant for them.
enemies.howToSpot: It draws its fists back, and the blow lands half a second later. Step away when the arms go back.

enemies.name: Glacial Runner
enemies.description: Shards in the shape of a wolf, held together by the song. Fast, and half of it is gaps: some of your shots will find them.
enemies.ability: Dodge: Has a chance to completely ignore an attack.
enemies.howToSpot: Fastest bite of all: a third of a second from the lunge to the jaws. A quick hop to one side means your shot missed it.

enemies.name: Cryo-Mage
enemies.description: A floating knot of white crystal carrying a bubble of dead light. Doesn't hit. Doesn't need to: every gun inside its ring fires slow. Pick one up; hands don't care.
enemies.ability: Chilling Aura: Slows the attack speed of nearby towers.
enemies.howToSpot: It never hits you. Look at the ground: guns inside its blue dashed ring fire slower. Kill it, or carry a gun out of the ring.

enemies.name: Permafrost Golem
enemies.description: Older than Skarnholt: a stone heart in a century of permafrost shell, and something in there wants out. Break the shell, then be quick.
enemies.ability: Shatter Armor: After taking enough damage, its armor breaks, increasing its speed and removing its damage reduction.
enemies.howToSpot: A slow hammer-fist: the blow lands half a second after the arm comes up. When its shell bursts it roars - then it runs, but takes full damage.

enemies.name: Subzero Burrower
enemies.description: The Rime's own miner. It tunnels through frozen earth faster than you mine light. Shoot it when it comes up for air.
enemies.ability: Burrow: Periodically becomes untargetable by moving underground.
enemies.howToSpot: It dives into the snow (you can't hit it down there) and bursts back out. Its bite lands 0.4 s after it rears up. Fire when it surfaces.

enemies.name: Rime-Warden
enemies.description: A solemn floating figure of clear ice with a heart of stone, and the stone sings. The others stand straighter near it. Shoot it first.
enemies.ability: Protect: other enemies within ~5 cells take 35% less damage (gold ring). The Warden is unprotected - shoot it first.
enemies.howToSpot: A gold dashed ring on the ground: enemies inside take less damage. Its spear lands about half a second after it draws back. Shoot the Warden first.

enemies.name: The Avalanche
enemies.description: A mountain's worth of snow and rock that learned to walk toward the song: the first colossus. When it roars, the storm comes with it. You get a breath of warning. Use it.
enemies.ability: Blizzard: every 15 s, after a warning ring, guns within ~7 cells take 60% longer between shots and reach 25% shorter for 5 s. Carried guns are never affected.
enemies.howToSpot: An orange ring fills in on the ground for 1.5 s. When it turns icy blue, guns inside fire much slower and reach shorter for 5 s. Pick a gun up or move it out.

enemies.name: The Hibernating Leviathan
enemies.description: The drill woke it. It freezes guns with a look, breathes frost through walls and drinks the warmth from what it breaks. It won't breathe on the Base; it wants what the Base is singing.
enemies.ability: Siege: an icy beam freezes your nearest gun for 3 s, and a warned frost-breath cone hits every structure in it for 300 (never the Base). Life Siphon: heals for a fifth of the damage it deals to buildings. Carried guns are never frozen - pick one up.
enemies.howToSpot: An orange cone fills in front of it for 2 s: get your buildings out of it - the frost breath hits everything inside. An orange ring under a gun means that gun is about to freeze; carried guns never do.

playerTab.title: TWO VIEWS
playerTab.body: Tab switches between FIRST PERSON (you walk, mine and feed towers yourself) and the RTS commander view (you order your character around and place buildings).

playerTab.title: FIRST PERSON
playerTab.body:
WASD move, mouse look, Space jump.
Hold Left Mouse facing a rock or crystal to mine it.
Hold F facing a tower to feed it your personal power - Healers, Batteries, Shield Projectors and Siphons run on it (look at one: its amber bar is its store). V: auto-feed the nearest tower that needs it.
Press T at a Stone Door to open or close it (anyone can).
Walk up to a tower, look at it and press E for its menu (upgrade, sell, take its gun). B opens build mode.

playerTab.title: RTS VIEW
playerTab.body:
WASD / screen edges pan, mouse wheel zooms.
Right Mouse on the ground to walk there, on a rock or crystal to mine it.
B opens the build bar: pick a tower, then Left Mouse on the grid to place (it stays armed; Shift-click queues). Esc puts it away; Backspace cancels your orders.
Left Mouse a placed tower to see its stats, upgrade it or sell it. On a tower that runs on power, FEED POWER (or F) sends your character to feed it; on a Stone Door, OPEN / CLOSE (or T). Click the Base (or press Home) for the mining / move upgrades. Click a crystal to see how much is left.
Esc (or P) opens the pause menu.

playerTab.title: SURVIVAL
playerTab.body:
Mine Red / Purple / Amber / Obsidian crystals (gray rocks give +5 of a random color). Carrying more than your capacity slows you; twice your capacity stops you.
Place a Base early - it's what the enemies attack, and its level caps your upgrades.
Generators power nearby towers; batteries store and relay power.
Prep is the short daylight. Then the dark comes once a match and stays; the quiet between waves is a night to rebuild. A boss walks every few waves (every 5th in a Standard match). Survive them all to win; if the base falls and everyone is down, you lose.

relics.name: Frozen Lantern
relics.lore: A miner's lantern, still faintly lit after who knows how long in the ice. Cut into the glass: three peaks over a closed eye. Skarnholt's mark, the old Company's. They lived under this ice before us, and they closed the eye on purpose.
relics.hint: A warm light glints in the rock maze, a short walk from where the cage sets you down. Walk into it to bring it home.
relics.reward: The Hollow's library alcove lights up and the lantern takes its place on the plinth.

book.title: The Skarnholt Ledger
book.text: Tallies in a tidy hand: red, purple, amber, obsidian, more loads every season. The last line is underlined twice: "Deep shaft opened. Bonus to all crews."

relics.name: Surveyor's Log
relics.lore: Water-stained pages in the Company surveyor's hand. The last entry: "The deep light sings at night. The colossi walk toward the song, not toward us. We are the ones making it louder. We sealed the lower gate."
relics.hint: After the first night, a survey stake glows far out past the landing site. The log lies beside it.
relics.reward: The survey table is restored and the map of the old tunnels goes up on the Hollow's wall.

book.title: Survey Notes, year three
book.text: A careful sketch of a colossus mid-stride, its head turned away from the camp. Under it, in the surveyor's hand: "toward the song."

relics.name: Heart of the Hollow
relics.lore: A shard of blue ice, warm in the hand, humming the note the deep light sings. The echo stones were keeping it. It fits the socket in the Company's gate.
relics.hint: Three echo stones hum somewhere in the maze. Wake all three in one match and follow the sound.
relics.reward: The sealed gate beneath the Hollow opens.

book.title: On Sealing a Gate
book.text: The Company's instructions, half washed out: "...white light, bled cold, poured in the socket... the Heart holds it... do not drill below the second bench."

relicIntro: Skarnholt left things in the ice. Walk into one to bring it home: each survivor earns their own, once per profile. Relics restore the Hollow and tell you what happened here. They never change your stats.

achievements.name: Master Architect
achievements.objective: Build a total of 500 buildings across all playthroughs.
achievements.bonus: All buildings cost 10% fewer resources to construct (rounded down).

achievements.name: Peak Performance
achievements.objective: Upgrade any single building to its maximum level (Level 8).
achievements.bonus: Upgrading buildings costs 5% fewer resources.

achievements.name: Fort Knox
achievements.objective: Have a single Battery store over 100,000 power.
achievements.bonus: All Batteries have their maximum power storage increased by 10%.

achievements.name: Flawless Defense
achievements.objective: Survive an entire wave (after wave 5) without losing a single building.
achievements.bonus: All buildings start with +5% maximum health.

achievements.name: Jack of All Trades
achievements.objective: Build every type of building AND upgrade each type to level 5 in a single match.
achievements.bonus: Permanently start with +55 of each resource.

achievements.name: Generator who?
achievements.objective: generate 100,000 total power from your character across all playthroughs.
achievements.bonus: Start every match with an extra +500 personal power capacity.

achievements.name: Maze Master
achievements.objective: Build a maze that forces a single enemy to walk at least 50 tiles further than its direct route to reach your base.
achievements.bonus: Wall maximum health is increased by 15%.

achievements.name: Glass Cannon
achievements.objective: Survive to wave 10 without building any defensive Walls.
achievements.bonus: Offensive towers cost 10% less power to fire.

achievements.name: The Great Wall
achievements.objective: Have 50 Wall structures active simultaneously in a single match.
achievements.bonus: Walls passively repair themselves for 1 HP every 3 seconds.

achievements.name: Sentry Duty
achievements.objective: Upgrade a single tower to Level 5 before Wave 5 begins.
achievements.bonus: Level 1 towers start with +10% base damage.

achievements.name: Overcharged
achievements.objective: Keep 10 of your towers at maximum power capacity for an entire wave (its whole day).
achievements.bonus: Towers have a 5% chance to not consume any power when they fire.

achievements.name: Demolition Expert
achievements.objective: Sell 250 buildings across all playthroughs.
achievements.bonus: Selling a building now refunds an additional 5% of its total cost.

achievements.name: Exterminator
achievements.objective: Kill 1,000 normal enemies across all playthroughs.
achievements.bonus: Turrets deal +5% damage to normal (non-boss) enemies.

achievements.name: Legendary Hunter
achievements.objective: Defeat 25 bosses across all playthroughs.
achievements.bonus: Turrets deal +10% damage to boss enemies.

achievements.name: Blitzkrieg
achievements.objective: Kill a Cryo-Mage within 5 seconds of it spawning, before its aura can take full effect.
achievements.bonus: All of your towers have a 5% chance per second to ignore the "chill" slowing effect from Cryo-Mages.

achievements.name: Retaliator
achievements.objective: Defeat 50 total enemies using the reflected damage from Spike Walls.
achievements.bonus: Spike Walls permanently reflect an additional 5% of incoming damage.

achievements.name: Sniper
achievements.objective: Kill 500 enemies from long range using long-range towers (Snipers).
achievements.bonus: All offensive towers gain +5% attack range.

achievements.name: David & Goliath
achievements.objective: Deal 10,000 total damage to bosses using only your character's Stomp ability.
achievements.bonus: Stomp ability radius is permanently increased by 50%.

achievements.name: Crowd Control
achievements.objective: Kill 10 enemies within a 1-second window.
achievements.bonus: Splash damage radius on all explosive weapons is increased by 5%.

achievements.name: Icebreaker
achievements.objective: Kill 250 FrostMites.
achievements.bonus: FrostMites move 5% slower permanently.

achievements.name: Giant Slayer
achievements.objective: Defeat a boss while your character has less than 20% health.
achievements.bonus: Deal +10% Stomp damage when your character is below 50% health.

achievements.name: No Man's Land
achievements.objective: Kill 100 enemies within 3 seconds of them spawning.
achievements.bonus: Towers deal +10% bonus damage to enemies at 100% full health.

achievements.name: Strip Miner
achievements.objective: Mine a total of 50,000 resources across all playthroughs.
achievements.bonus: Start every match with +1 permanent mining yield.

achievements.name: Resource Hoarder
achievements.objective: Hold more than 25,000 of a single resource type (e.g., 25,001 Red) at one time.
achievements.bonus: Your personal resource carrying capacity is permanently increased by 500

achievements.name: Industrialist
achievements.objective: Generate 1,000,000 total power from Generators across all playthroughs.
achievements.bonus: All Generators (H. and D. types) produce 5% more power per second.

achievements.name: Energy Independence
achievements.objective: Win a match without building any Power Generators (Batteries and personal power are allowed).
achievements.bonus: Your personal power generation from the gear upgrade is increased by 10%.

achievements.name: Maximum Efficiency
achievements.objective: Reach the hard cap for mining speed (200ms) in any match.
achievements.bonus: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your base player movement speed.

achievements.name: Time to start Hiking
achievements.objective: Become so over-encumbered that you can not move.
achievements.bonus: Start every match with an extra +500 personal carry capacity.

achievements.name: Spectrum Miner
achievements.objective: Mine 100,000 of Red, Purple, Green, and White resources each.
achievements.bonus: 5% chance to get double resources on every successful mine.

achievements.name: Speed Demon
achievements.objective: Maintain maximum movement speed for 60 consecutive seconds.
achievements.bonus: Movement speed penalty when carrying heavy resources is reduced by 5%.

achievements.name: Penny Pincher
achievements.objective: Spend exactly 0 resources for the first 3 waves of a match.
achievements.bonus: STOMP ability damage is permanently doubled.

achievements.name: Philanthropist
achievements.objective: Transfer 50,000 total power to buildings from your character (hold F).
achievements.bonus: Your personal power transfer rate to buildings is 20% faster.

achievements.name: Hardened Survivor
achievements.objective: Successfully win a match on "Hard" difficulty.
achievements.bonus: Gain +0.5 additional skill point every time you level up.

achievements.name: Frost-Born
achievements.objective: Successfully win a match on "Insane" difficulty.
achievements.bonus: Gain +0.25 additional skill point every time you level up.

achievements.name: Close one
achievements.objective: Finish a match with health missing.
achievements.bonus: Your passive health regeneration outside of combat is slightly increased.

achievements.name: Capitalist
achievements.objective: End a match with over 50,000 total resources remaining in your inventory.
achievements.bonus: You get a 10% higher refund when selling buildings.

achievements.name: Gear Head
achievements.objective: Fully unlock and max out every single permanent gear upgrade
achievements.bonus: Rainbow outline around character?

achievements.name: Untouched
achievements.objective: Complete the first 5 waves of a match without your character taking a single step.
achievements.bonus: map wide placement of buildings, you don't need to move anyways.

achievements.name: Close Call
achievements.objective: Survive a wave with you at exactly 1 HP.
achievements.bonus: The very first time your base takes fatal damage in a match, it doesn't die. Instead, it drops to exactly 1 HP and gets a 3-second invulnerability shield.

achievements.name: Marathon Runner
achievements.objective: Play the game for a total of 10 hours.
achievements.bonus: All resource storage limits in buildings are increased by 15%.

achievements.name: The First Step
achievements.objective: Successfully complete Wave 1 for the very first time.
achievements.bonus: Start every match with +1 maximum Player HP.

achievements.name: Perfectionist
achievements.objective: Win a match without repairing any buildings.
achievements.bonus: All buildings gain a permanent +5% innate damage reduction armor.

achievements.name: I Can Read!
achievements.objective: Successfully complete the tutorial.
achievements.bonus: Gain 1 permanent skill point and start every match with +20 of each resource.

achievements.name: Made You Look
achievements.objective: Scroll to the very bottom of the achievement list.
achievements.bonus: Unlocks the Stats page from the main menu.

achievements.name: Hold the Hollow
achievements.objective: Survive Endless wave 20 on Normal or harder.
achievements.bonus: Lights the first lamp on the Company's machine in the deep workshop. Story only.

lengths.name: Short
lengths.description: A quick night. About 15 minutes: 12 waves that ramp up fast.

lengths.name: Standard
lengths.description: A full night. About 30 minutes: 20 waves.

lengths.name: Long
lengths.description: A long one. Pack boots. About 45 minutes: 28 waves with longer nights to build.

lengths.name: Endless
lengths.description: The Long Night: the cage comes when the Base falls. After wave 10 the waves grow fast; survive wave 20 on Normal or harder to hold the Hollow. Your best wave is recorded.

upgradeCost.name: Obsidian Only
upgradeCost.description: All player upgrades will only cost Obsidian crystals.

upgradeCost.name: Standard
upgradeCost.description: Uses specific element per stat (Ex: Speed=Amber, Yield=Obsidian).

upgradeCost.name: Randomized
upgradeCost.description: The color required for an upgrade changes randomly every time.

hints.text: A BOSS wave: one huge enemy that shrugs off tower fire. Aim your own shots at its glowing weak spots - they hit for double.
Gray rocks give a few crystals of a random color. Colored crystals always give their own color.
Your load is getting heavy. Past your carry limit you move at half speed: spend crystals on buildings, and bank Heartstone at your Base.
A Shield Wall's shield only works while it has power: keep it in reach of a Generator.
A tower ran out of power and stopped firing. Build a Generator in its reach, or feed it your own POWER (F).
Heartstone! It is heavy, and it only counts once you bank it at your Base. Heartstone still in your pocket when the match ends is lost.
This tower runs on POWER. Look at it and hold F to feed it yours (commander view: select it, FEED POWER). Your POWER refills at the Base.
Stone Door: press T at it to open or close it (anyone can, even with a gun in hand). Open, it lets enemies through too; it shuts itself 6 s after you're clear.
No walls yet. In a few nights the waves get big enough to reach your Base. Block the way in with Spike Walls so your towers can hold them.

keybinds.action: Skip the day (start the next wave now)
Feed power to a tower (hold; commander view: the selected tower)
Open / close a door; your Shield Wall's field
